editorial_review_issues.decision: Do not import isolated heading I003 as a quantitative claim; inspect original Sustainable Hospitality Alliance and Currie & Brown studies before publishing figures.
Seven room modes and illustrative ten-minute timeout are ABB-specific; retain taxonomy as separate structured source context only, hold isolated timer I037.
Overlap with CAT010 ABB GRMS is 26 records; these are two publications from the same company and not independent proof of an NSP feature.
Block feature-bank promotion of ABB's four-layer security, KNX IP-Secure, network segmentation and secure IP technical claims. Related partner certification may not be attributed to NSP.
GuestFlow Vision, GuestFlow Editor, mySmartSuite and InSite are ABB-only research references. No tested NSP functionality, screenshots or certifications are implied.
Apply three precision corrections to translations at S07, preserve original S03/S05 history and English quotes.
Seventeen source topics without NSP section may be retained as unassigned internal competitor research. They must not create a fourth NSP system or auto-attach to GRMS/public areas.
Hold I097/I098: InterContinental Madrid and ABB pump/drive efficiency claims are not NSP projects or measured results. Page 97 photo is visual layout reference only.
Entire slide excluded from extracted quotes, images and any individual contact details.
AI-generated content may be incorrect is a reliability warning, not a publishable feature. Hold I100.
All 19 cropped images are internal design research. Direct commercial reuse, product claims and external publication need independently established rights and NSP originals.
HELP.json 2.0.0 is canonical; BINDER_COVER and COVER remain distinct, and section ordering is separate from fixed page numbers.
